row.protocol_en: Complete-model inference path. Timing includes online input/weight preparation, projection computation, scale restoration, reduction, and output conversion, including the long-prefill temporary INT8 buffer. Candidate construction, calibration, and offline packing precede request timing. Resident and peak values are allocated GPU memory in GiB, with activations, KV states, and temporary weights counted according to runtime lifetimes. PPL belongs to the separate quality record, not a simultaneous measurement on this workload.
